overview_text: The biology and international business combined major prepares students to become versatile leaders in the global economy who can navigate the complex intersection of life sciences and commerce. The program develops professionals who can bridge the gap between laboratory innovation and worldwide commercial impact. The program integrates rigorous training in biological sciences with comprehensive international business education. As the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries become increasingly globalized, companies require professionals who not only understand the science behind their products but can also manage international regulatory frameworks, cross-cultural partnerships, and global market strategies. Students develop deep scientific literacy—enabling them to evaluate research, understand product development pipelines, and communicate effectively with R&D teams about innovations in human health and therapeutics. Students integrate scientific knowledge with the strategic, financial, and cross-cultural competencies essential for launching products across borders, negotiating with international stakeholders, and leading teams in multicultural environments.
